Curious Ventures

Curious Ventures is a pre-seed fund built around one thing: the founder. We move into residencies, founder houses and network states, live alongside the builders there, and back the ones on the way up. Then we put our whole ecosystem to work to help them grow.

Why Curious

The market funds proof.We fund potential.

Pre-seed is a bet on a person before the product is proven. So we stay consistent on how we find and back founders, and open on what they build.

Who we back

Every breakout has a moment before it.

The product is rough, the numbers are early, and the founder is already becoming someone the market will chase in two years. That moment is where we invest.

Today

The founder is the thesis.

The world moves faster than any sector thesis can keep up with. AI, creators, wellness, longevity, energy, deep tech: if a founder is on the way up, we are interested, wherever they are building.

Where we find them

Inside the high-trust nodes.

Residencies, founder houses, popup villages and network states. Every place we live in becomes a high-trust node, and when a great founder appears inside one, we are already there.

How we work

We find them before the market does.

Categories will change. Cities will change. The road will keep going. What stays constant is the method.

Step one

Show up.

We move into residencies, founder houses and network states, and live where the next generation of founders is building. Young talent, experienced builders and senior operators, all in one house.

Step two

Live together.

Weeks of building side by side tell us more than any deck. A pitch shows you a founder's best hour. A residency shows you all of them. Diligence is a byproduct of living together.

Step three

Back the founder.

We write the first check on potential, at the moment one believer changes the trajectory. Pre-seed is the longest relationship you will have with a founder, and we show up for all of it.

Step four

Help them grow.

A pre-seed investor is a multiplier. Customers, co-investors, talent, distribution and a house full of builders: whatever leverage our ecosystem holds goes to work for our founders.

Distribution isthe only moat.
